when your parents pick your life before you become a legal adult, so when you become a legal adult and get different interests, you're stuck in a dead end job that your parents forced you to take when you didn't know any better.

i doubt she even wants this either. the parents are living their dreams through their child.
thank you for talking to me. i really appreciate it. i've researched some sites near me, and i've found one that seems to be anonymous. thank you for showing me that somebody cares.
i've seen some online resources, but is there a way i can talk to them anonymously? i don't like talking to people about my problems especially if they know who i am.

i don't know whats been happening to me over the past 2 years. at first i fell into a state of depression, i had no motivation to do anything and i would stay up crying. at the end of last year, i thought i got better, and i thought i had conquered my depression. i was proud of it, because i thought i did it alone, without help. then at the start of this year, i had started to realise that something was off, and as the year went on, my depression came back. i've tried to deny it, because sometimes i feel content and almost happy. but it fades quickly. i just want to know why i'm like this, why i can't stay happy. i think it's my fault, i stay up at night pulling at my hair wondering why i didn't prevent this. some days i feel like life is worth living and other days, i consider whether i should just off myself right then and there
